turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello, how are things going?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pretty good so far.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I freelance and my income is all over the place. How do I budget?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Irregular income needs a slightly different approach. Start by working out your bare minimum monthly costs.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, and another thing. My kids bring home paintings every day. The fridge is buried.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lovely problem, but a real one. Would you photograph them and keep only a few favourites, or have one keepsake box per child per year?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Come look at this.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just a second, Moshi, let me deal with this.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Could you hold this for a sec?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Got it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Emma, can you look at my resume for a second?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure. Hmm, it's pretty long.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is two pages too much?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: For you, yeah. Cut the part about your summer job from college.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: But I learned a lot there.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then mention it in the interview. On paper, keep it focused on this job.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, okay, I'm back. Hit me.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. So, the paintings. Have you settled on a way to keep them?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A box each. I can't bring myself to throw their art away.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Totally understandable. Write the date on the back and the boxes become a little time capsule.
